## Overview

**Morgath, The Red Maw** — an ancient Balor and one of the Scourge's most feared warlords before Khar'Zul's rise. He was everything the Scourge expected from a demon commander: brutal, overwhelming, and convinced that strength alone was enough to win a war. His armies were infamous for crushing their enemies through sheer force, leaving nothing but ruins behind. His defeat at Khar'Zul's hands in the Gathering of the Spoils marked the beginning of Khar'Zul's ascent through the Scourge's ranks.

---

## The Duel with Khar'Zul

Khar'Zul had watched Morgath's campaigns for years. He saw what others did not: Morgath wasted soldiers, resources, and opportunities simply because he possessed the strength to do so. To Khar'Zul, that was not power — it was inefficiency.

The two Balor met alone upon a battlefield surrounded by their armies. Morgath expected a contest of strength. Instead, Khar'Zul studied him — every movement, every attack, every opening observed and remembered. What appeared to be a desperate struggle was, in truth, Khar'Zul learning exactly how his opponent fought. When Morgath finally committed to a decisive strike, Khar'Zul stepped into the attack and exploited the weakness he had been waiting for. Morgath fell, his torso split from his legs.

By the law of the Gathering of the Spoils, Morgath's army — thousands of creatures — became Khar'Zul's spoils. They now stood before the Balor who had defeated their former master not through strength, but through understanding.
